verdict.rationale: Cline documents an SDK-like integration surface ("Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine"), so an API reference is a fair question for this product. The pack has no evidence of an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. llms.txt and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation, an adjacent feature that does not deliver an explorable, runnable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
